releaseNotes:
Rookline 0.6.24 improves fitted tyre recovery, translucent used-tyre rings, flat/detached/full-wear pulses, damage indicators and separate oil/engine warnings. A witnessed engine failure is retained across cooling and matching-context Rookline restarts until an observed Garage return. Fuel-only classes hide NRG; repeated HUD updates avoid unnecessary DOM changes, historical scans are deferred, and mechanical-failure mode is read once per event. Compound calibration and remaining native startup checks continue.

Rookline installs and runs independently. RookForce is a separate optional application with its own installation and interface.

The Windows installer is not Authenticode-signed. Rookline verifies its published SHA-256 and version through this HTTPS manifest before updater launch. No new installed-upgrade, native game-performance or hardware validation is claimed.
